description: Reads throttle inputs, raw A voltage, and plausibility status for the configured channels.

outputPorts.name: A
outputPorts.description: Normalized throttle channel A in the range 0 to 1.

outputPorts.name: B
outputPorts.description: Normalized throttle channel B in the range 0 to 1; zero when B is disabled.

outputPorts.name: Valid
outputPorts.description: True when the configured throttle inputs pass plausibility (A only or A+B).

outputPorts.name: A_V
outputPorts.description: Raw throttle 1/A ADC pin voltage in volts (Gen7 PA3), before normalization and plausibility masking.
